description: R6 (behavioral-spec.md:46-50) names EmpireDashboard.tsx to render the leaderboard but tells you to extend useDashboard.ts's DashboardData type. EmpireDashboard.tsx does NOT use the useDashboard hook; it declares its own local interface DashboardData { updated_at; mrr; goals } (EmpireDashboard.tsx:52-56) and fetches /dashboard.json itself (EmpireDashboard.tsx:64-76), reading data.mrr.total_usd and data.goals.progress_pct. Extending useDashboard.ts's type does nothing for the render component; which type carries leaderboard is ambiguous and EmpireDashboard's mrr/goals contract already diverges from telemetry-aggregate.js:11 output. Not concretely implementable.

evidence.snippet: interface DashboardData { updated_at: string; mrr: {...}; goals: {...} }
